CustomField.description: Returns whether Account Review Activity Date was Platinum <90 Gold< 30, Silver < 90
CustomField.formula: IF ( AND( ISPICKVAL ( Customer_Category__c , "Industry - Platinum"), TODAY() - Last_Account_Review_Date__c < 30) , 1 , IF( AND ( ISPICKVAL ( Customer_Category__c , "Industry - Gold"), TODAY() - Last_Account_Review_Date__c < 30 ), 1, IF ( AND ( ISPICKVAL ( Customer_Category__c , "Industry - Silver"), TODAY() - Last_Account_Review_Date__c < 90) , 1, 0 )))
CustomField.label: Account Review Completed?
